simple.meaning: מַלְבּוּשׁ (malbûwsh) is a Hebrew object word meaning “a garment , or (collectively) clothing.” BibleIQ follows the concrete thing through the verses where it appears.
simple.biblicalBackground: The occurrence trail begins at 1 Kings 10:5. The background is built from the passages where the word occurs.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to מַלְבּוּשׁ (H4403) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: Concrete words often carry patterns through Scripture because objects, animals, offerings, and created things are used repeatedly in worship, judgment, covenant, and narrative.
simple.summary: מַלְבּוּשׁ (malbûwsh) / H4403 is traced through 1 Kings 10:5, 2 Kings 10:22, 2 Chronicles 9:4, Job 27:16 with generated occurrence evidence.

firstOccurrence.englishText: the food of his table, the sitting of his servants, the attendance of his officials, their clothing, his cup bearers, and his ascent by which he went up to Yahweh’s house; there was no more spirit in her.

timeline.evidenceText: the food of his table, the sitting of his servants, the attendance of his officials, their clothing, his cup bearers, and his ascent by which he went up to Yahweh’s house; there was no more spirit in her.
He said to him who kept the wardrobe, “Bring out robes for all the worshipers of Baal!”

the food of his table, the seating of his servants, the attendance of his ministers, their clothing, his cup bearers also, their clothing, and his ascent by which he went up to Yahweh’s house; there was no more spirit in her.

the food of his table, the seating of his servants, the attendance of his ministers, their clothing, his cup bearers also, their clothing, and his ascent by which he went up to Yahweh’s house; there was no more spirit in her.
Though he heap up silver as the dust,
“I have trodden the wine press alone.

Thus you were decked with gold and silver. Your clothing was of fine linen, silk, and embroidered work. You ate fine flour, honey, and oil. You were exceedingly beautiful, and you prospered to royal estate.
It will happen in the day of Yahweh’s sacrifice, that I will punish the princes, the king’s sons, and all those who are clothed with foreign clothing.

definitions.full: H4403. malbush מַלְבּוּשׁ , [ מַלְבֻּשׁ ] noun masculine Zeph 1:8 raiment, attire ; — absolute 2Kin 10:22 2 t.; suffix מַלְבּוּשֵׁךְ Ezek 16:3 ; plural suffix מַלְבּוּשַׁי Isa 63:3 ; מַלְבּוּשִׁיהֶם 2Chr 9:4 (twice in verse), מַלְבֻּשֵׁיהֶם 1Kin 10:5 ; — raiment , 2Kin 10:22 (for worshippers, || לְבוּשׁ ), Job 27:16 (as wealth); of Jerusalem under figure of infant Ezek 16:13 ; ׳מַל נָכְרִי Zeph 1:8 foreign attire (accusative with לָבַשׁ ); plural of garments of Solomon's servants 1Kin 10:5 2Chr 9:4 a, + 9:4 b; of ׳י under figure of warrior Isa 63:3 .
